title: Business Analyst -BRE
jobDescription:
Are you passionate about solving roadblocks & challenges faced by MSMEs in India? MSMEs contribute significantly to India’s total GDP. 90% of India’s ~$1 Trillion Retail Market is controlled by Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSMEs). Which means ~$900B worth of commerce flows through these ~60M MSMEs in the form of shops/kiosks/homes, scattered all over the country. We at Khatabook, have a vision to empower MSMEs and help them increase their incomes. We have built a product that brings efficiency in MSME operations by providing them easy to use tools to manage their receivables, inventory and billing which creates transparency in their cash flow. Within the Khatabook platform, we have also enabled the facility to take loans for their short term working capital needs for select Khatabook users that are displaying good credit behavior. Our app has been downloaded over 100 Million times with a monthly active user base of 8 Million+ which are adding 220 Million+ transactions with a transaction value of $18 Billion. Why work with us? People are our biggest asset! At Khatabook, every one of us is a dynamic superstar. We have carefully bred an ecosystem which hires nothing but incredibly and exceptionally talented people who can dream, collaborate, experiment, and break new ground. We’re a strong team that looks out for each other. Your role We, at Khatabook, are looking for a Business Analyst
- BRE to manage, enhance, and optimize our Business Rule Engine (BRE) for lending and risk decisioning. The role will focus on translating credit and risk policies into system logic, driving continuous improvements, and working closely with product, risk, and technology teams to ensure seamless implementation and governance of decision frameworks. What would you do at Khatabook? Own end-to-end management of the business rule engine, including rule creation, validation, testing, and deployment. Translate credit policies into executable system rules in collaboration with product and engineering teams. Monitor BRE performance across approval rates, risk outcomes, and portfolio quality, and recommend rule optimizations. Creating BRD and testing functionalities of the BRD Management System platform Perform in-depth analysis on funnel metrics, rejection reasons, ATS, and risk cohorts to improve decision quality. Support UAT and post-deployment monitoring for all policy and rule changes. Build dashboards and MIS to track BRE effectiveness, stability, and business impact. Evaluate experiments and policy pilots to assess impact before full-scale rollout. What are we looking for? 1-2 years of experience in analytics. Technical capabilities: Proficient in SQL and Excel. Strong working experience with BI tools (Tableau, Qlikview, Power BI, Cognos, BO, Pentaho, etc. ) Strong understanding of statistics and experience with statistical analysis Strong quantitative abilities, distinctive problem-solving, and excellent analysis skills Strong organizational, communication, presentation and project management skills A background in statistical modeling and experience with statistical/scripting tools such as R, Python, Spark, SAS, or SPSS is a plus. Prior experience in credit risk analytics or policy management is a plus.

We, at Khatabook, are looking for a passionate QA Engineer to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of our mobile and API products. You’ll be an integral part of the product lifecycle — from understanding features and writing test cases to identifying bugs and ensuring smooth releases. What would you do at Khatabook? Perform functional, UI, regression, and negative testing for end-to-end product flows (e.g., OTP login, payments, search). Identify, document, and track bugs using tools like JIRA or Linear. Familiarity with API concepts, HTTP methods, and JSON response validation. Basic understanding of test automation concepts (e.g., Appium, Selenium, Rest-Assured). Excellent analytical, debugging, and communication skills. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (preferred) . Nice to Have Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, mock servers, or API automation. Understanding of performance testing and app instrumentation. Ability to write simple code in Java/Python for small automation tasks.
